entries.label: CO  52  Faedis Hands

tags.subject: solid ink gloves
tags.placement: back of both hands, wrists, and lower forearm-cuffs

entries.description: A heavy fill of solid black ink that covers the entire back of each hand, wraps around the wrist, and continues down the forearm as a thick cuff. Edges are soft and feathered, reading like long opera-style gloves dyed straight into the skin.

entries.label: CO  53  Ziva Hands

tags.subject: small tribal flame mark
tags.placement: outer wrist of each hand, near the base of the thumb

entries.description: A compact, flame-shaped tribal sigil sits on the outer wrist of each hand, formed of two curved hooks framed by a vertical row of small dots. The mark is small and self-contained, leaving the fingers, knuckles, and back of the hand bare.

entries.label: CO  51  Nexregiant Hands Female

tags.subject: filled tribal gauntlets
tags.placement: back of both hands, wrists, and full forearm-cuffs

entries.description: Heavy mirrored tribal fills sheath the back of each hand and run as a thick gauntlet up the wrist and forearm. Small dragon-head flourishes curl over the knuckle base while the cuff itself is a near-solid block of ink with carved negative-space slits.

entries.id: CO 56 Smoke Bones Hands Base Female
entries.label: CO  56  Smoke Bones Hands Base Female

tags.subject: skeletal hand x-ray
tags.placement: back of both hands, fingers, and wrists

entries.description: A clean skeletal anatomy laid over each hand, with metacarpal and phalange bones running from the wrist to each fingertip and short bars at the knuckles. The wrist edge shows the cut-off of the radius and ulna, like an x-ray plate.

entries.id: CO 56 Smoke Bones Hands Tribal L1 Female
entries.label: CO  56  Smoke Bones Hands Tribal L 1  Female

tags.subject: spider-and-eye tribal cluster
tags.placement: back of both hands and outer wrist

entries.description: A central spider-like motif with an oval body sits on the back of each hand, flanked by a four-pointed star accent and topped by a single vertical bar that runs up the wrist. A small chevron and dotted accent sit just below near the knuckles.

entries.id: CO 56 Smoke Bones Hands Tribal L2 Female
entries.label: CO  56  Smoke Bones Hands Tribal L 2  Female

tags.subject: scattered tribal sparks and slashes
tags.placement: back of both hands and the base of the fingers

entries.description: A loose pattern of small curl-hooks, short bars and tiny dots scattered across the back of each hand, with a horizontal row of dashes running along the knuckle base. Nothing fills the design — it reads as scattered ash flecks of ink.

entries.label: CO  57  Egyptaris Hands V 1  Female

tags.subject: etched tribal armour-wrap
tags.placement: back of both hands, wrists, and forearm-cuffs

entries.description: A linework armour-wrap that follows the back of each hand, splits across the wrist into segmented bands, and continues up the forearm with curling tendrils and a stylised eye. A small ankh-like glyph sits centred on the back of each hand.

entries.label: CO  57  Egyptaris Hands V 2  Female

tags.subject: etched tribal armour-wrap with arrow vamp
tags.placement: back of both hands with a chevron over the knuckles, wrists, and forearm-cuffs

entries.description: A linework armour-wrap close in spirit to the V1 layout, but with a long chevron vamp pointing down the back of the hand toward the knuckles. Wrist bands and forearm tendrils repeat, and a small ankh-like glyph sits high on the wrist.

entries.label: CO  58  Quake Hand Female

tags.subject: cracked-stone shard mosaic
tags.placement: back and outer side of the left hand and wrist

entries.description: A single-hand design only, covering the back and outer edge of the left hand with a dense mosaic of irregular black shards separated by thin pale cracks. The pattern reads like splintered obsidian plating laid directly onto the skin.

entries.label: CO  58  Aquasar Hand Female

tags.subject: spiked spiral medallion
tags.placement: back of the left hand

entries.description: A single-hand design only — a thick black disc sitting on the back of the left hand, ringed with sharp outward-pointing spines and carved with a wide negative-space spiral in its centre. The right hand is left bare.

entries.label: CO  62  Blood Curse Hands Female

tags.subject: branching vein cracks
tags.placement: back of both hands, wrists, and lower forearm

entries.description: A spread of thin, fractal capillary lines that branch like burst blood vessels or roots crawling up from the wrist onto the back of each hand. There is no symmetry and no central motif — only creeping, curse-like veins under the skin.

entries.label: CO  65  Flora Iter Hand Female

tags.subject: tribal henna-style hand-piece
tags.placement: back of the left hand, fingers, and wrist

entries.description: A single-hand design only — an ornate filigree fills the back of the left hand with curls, eyes and chevrons, and continues onto every finger as banded segments. The wrist anchor flares outward in a heavy decorative cuff.

entries.label: CO  66  Aquadynamis Hands Female

tags.subject: stylized aquatic tribal scripts
tags.placement: outer wrist and back of both hands above the knuckles

entries.description: Two small mirrored motifs per hand: a curling fish-tail glyph at the outer wrist and a larger, denser calligraphic flourish across the back of the hand just above the knuckles. The shapes flow like brushed cursive in a stylised aquatic script.

entries.label: CO  68  Brimflame Hand Female

tags.subject: spear-and-vine tribal flame
tags.placement: back of both hands, wrists, and forearm-cuffs

entries.description: A long pointed spearhead motif sits at the wrist of each arm, with curling flame-vines branching outward to wrap the back of the hand and run up the forearm. Internal stripes of negative space give it the look of layered banded flame.

entries.label: CO  70  Ancient Ward Hand Female

tags.subject: arc of blocky ward glyphs
tags.placement: outer wrist and side of both hands, arcing toward the base of the fingers

entries.description: A column of chunky, square-cornered ward glyphs runs along the outer edge of each hand, curving from the wrist up to the base of the little finger. The characters read as a stylised lost-language inscription, framed by simple bar borders.

entries.label: CO Extra Hands Arcus Female

tags.subject: row of tiny spike marks
tags.placement: thin band across the base of the fingers on both hands

entries.description: A narrow row of small spike-shaped tick marks runs across the base of the fingers on each hand, like a string of tally cuts laid where a ring would sit. The marks are tiny, evenly spaced, and entirely confined to the knuckle-base band.
